buckets.title: Needs action soon
buckets.description: Automated mail that needs a human action soon: service and infrastructure alerts (outages, end-of-support notices, security warnings), failed or declined payments, expiring cards, account suspension warnings, deadlines within about a week, legal or compliance notices, and anything marked "Action Required" that is genuinely actionable.
positive_examples: cloud provider health and outage alerts
buckets.priority_when_ambiguous: When something is both an alert and a receipt, prefer this label.

buckets.title: Reading material
buckets.description: Newsletters, Substack and similar sends, mailing-list digests, keyword-alert bots, industry news roundups, and vendor product-marketing announcements the user did not personally ask about. Reading material, no action.

buckets.title: Event invitations
buckets.description: Event invitations and logistics from platforms: meetups, conferences, summits, webinars, demo days, ticketing and RSVP-platform invites, RSVP-activity and post-event survey notifications, early-bird deadlines.
negative_examples: Event mail from a named human collaborator about an event the user is co-hosting is person-to-person correspondence: leave it in the inbox.

buckets.title: Receipts and statements
buckets.description: Receipts, invoices, billing statements, payment confirmations, subscription renewals, bank and card statements, expense-tool and travel-spend reports, routine payment-account notices. Successful and routine only.
negative_examples: Anything failed or overdue belongs in 1-Daily.

buckets.title: Cold outreach
buckets.description: Cold outbound from vendors and founders, sales follow-ups ("just following up", "one last message"), recruiting-service and candidate-sourcing blasts, sponsorship and expo solicitations, unsolicited demo requests. Low priority, batch-review monthly.
positive_examples: "just following up on my last note"
"can I get 15 minutes on your calendar?"

buckets.title: Applicants
buckets.description: Inbound hiring pipeline for the user's own open roles: automated new-application notifications, applicant-tracking and job-board notices about candidates who applied, interview-scheduling bot mail. These are people who applied and deserve a real weekly pass.
positive_examples: "new application for …" from an applicant-tracking system
negative_examples: Recruiting vendors selling sourcing services or blasting candidate lists are cold outreach: 5-Monthly-Pitches.
A named candidate or hiring collaborator writing directly is person-to-person correspondence: leave it in the inbox.
buckets.priority_when_ambiguous: Direction matters: candidates coming in belong here; vendors selling in do not.
